name: Ultimaker S5
offsetHandling: firmware: commands are in the active nozzle's build coordinates; do not subtract the nominal offset again

exportGuidance.header: Use a complete Griffin header, including GENERATOR.BUILD_DATE, the active tool's MATERIAL.GUID and BUILD_VOLUME.TEMPERATURE. The accepted PLA demo uses Generic PLA GUID 506c9f0d-e3aa-4bd4-b2d2-23e2425b1aa9 and build-volume temperature 28 C.
exportGuidance.troubleshooting: A file rejected as missing necessary data may have incomplete metadata even when libCharon accepts it. Compare with a Cura S5 export; UFP contains /3D/model.gcode.
exportGuidance.acceptance: User reports firmware 8.3.1 accepted the SAAM 0.2.2 metadata correction from USB. The later no-routine-leveling startup and Griffin-4.4 compatibility declaration have software checks only; neither establishes successful printing or clearance.

nonplanar.basis: Bounded working limit for surface-following layers with this fixed vertical nozzle. Set from the inclination range the wedge demo was built around; it is not a measured clearance rating and no head collision model is implemented.
nonplanar.validation: software limit only; no physical print has established it

startup.validation: standard S5 Griffin startup without a per-job leveling routine is assumed; installed firmware and verification are optional metadata

validation: software definition; no physical print validation
